integrity: Finite arithmetic code and checked polynomial representations are included with all dependencies; same-model scientific review only, with no independent audit or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Completeness only, not an all-q frequency formula; the standard Weil bound supplies the infinite range and a nine-field independently re-enumerable finite arithmetic certificate supplies the sharp exceptions; implicit priority in older or unindexed tables remains possible.
title: Sharp cubic-coset triple universality over proper finite-field extensions
